byReaction.description: Mention everyone who reacted to a message with an emoji

notReact.description: Mention the members who did not react to a message

everyone.description: Send a message with @everyone in the current thread

messageLinkOption.description: Link of the message (right-click, Copy Message Link)

emojiOption.description: The emoji to look for; pick one from the suggestions

replyMessageOption.description: Link of a message to reply to with the list

roleOption.description: Only members with this role are expected to react

isReplyOption.description: Reply to the message itself with the list (default: no)

onlyInChannelOption.description: Only members who can see the channel; false takes the whole role (default: yes)

author: (author)

reactors.header: Reply to {user}, there are {count} user(s) who [reacted to the message]({url}) with {emoji}:

nonReactors.header: Reply to {user}, there are {count} user(s) who [did not react to the message]({url}):

noReactors: No one reacted with that emoji.
allReacted: Everyone in the role reacted to the message.
unsupportedChannel: This does not work in voice or stage channels, or in a channel that holds no messages.
notAThread: This command can only be used in a thread.
replyNotFound: The message to reply to was not found.
sendPartial: Sent {sent} of {total} messages, then Discord refused: {reason}
